rationale:
Evidence from iteration 1 (60 trials, every run still ended off_track, score 75.97, up from 26.04): max_error is 0.061 on oval, 0.065 on s-bend and 0.061 on slalom, so the robot still leaves the 0.06 m limit on every track. Line losses remain near 2 per trial on the s-bend (1.95) and slalom (2.0). Steering oscillation rose sharply to 0.23 on the s-bend and 0.14 on the slalom, against 0.07 to 0.11 on the oval and about 0.07 in iteration 0. Progress improved on the s-bend (0.04 to 0.29) and oval (0.115 to 0.16), so the tighter sensors and higher kp helped, but the robot still fails at the first sharp bends.

Interpretation: the Evaluator rule for high oscillation with small max_error does not apply, because max_error is not small. The rule for max_error near 0.06 with line losses does apply, and the Evaluator named base_speed as the likelier cause. The high oscillation on the s-bend, with kd at 0.2 amplifying 10 ms sensor noise and kp at 2.0 giving a large differential, makes me think the derivative term is adding jitter that pushes the robot off the tape.

Changes: (1) base_speed 1.4 to 1.2, one Evaluator-suggested step, so the robot has more time to correct on bends (H1: line losses and max_error fall, and progress holds because the failure point moves later). (2) kd 0.2 to 0.1, to cut the jitter the Evaluator flagged, since oscillation rose about three times on the s-bend (H2: steering_oscillation falls below 0.15 without raising max_error). kp stays at 2.0 and ki at 0, and the sensor geometry and weights are unchanged, so the effect of each change can be read from the race. I expect max_error to drop below 0.06 on the oval and slalom, line_loss_events to fall to 0 to 1, and completion to remain 0 unless speed is raised later.

Measurements wanted next: max_error and where it peaks on each track, line_loss_events per track, steering_oscillation (to confirm the kd change), progress per track, and completion_time if any run finishes. If the next race shows low oscillation and max_error still near 0.06, raise kp to 2.5. If oscillation is still high with kd 0.1, lower kd to 0.05.
